marketing.heroBadge: Real problems first, practice that sticks
marketing.heroSubtitle: Every module starts from a real problem, shows you a real run, lets you build it yourself with hints, and brings the idea back weeks later. A capstone and a final check close the course.
marketing.heroPrompt: What do you want to be able to do?
marketing.statGate: pass mark on the final check
marketing.marqueeLabel: Research the method is built on
marketing.methodTitle: From a real problem to lasting skill
marketing.methodBody: Every module takes its own topics in the same order. After all modules: one capstone, one final check and a wrap-up.
marketing.ruleFeedback: Feedback on every practice answer, so mistakes become learning while they are fresh.
marketing.ruleChunk: New ideas per segment, at most
marketing.teamsTitle: See who is stuck before they drop out
marketing.teamsBody: Org admins assign courses and manage seats. Instructors see their own learners’ progress and where they are stuck, and can message them.
marketing.teamsPoint1: Seats, assignments and access windows per course
marketing.teamsPoint2: Instructors see only the learners assigned to them
marketing.teamsPoint3: Completion, final-check pass rate and where learners drop off
marketing.teamsPoint4: Courses in your team’s languages, reviewed by native speakers
marketing.pricingTitle: Simple plans for people and teams
marketing.faq_q1: Is this just videos with a quiz at the end?
marketing.faq_q1_a: No. Videos are short segments with a check every few minutes. Most of your time goes into watching real runs, building with hints, and recall checks that bring ideas back weeks later.
marketing.faq_q2_a: Drafts are generated from expert source material, then checked by automatic validators and reviewed by people for accuracy before anything is published.
marketing.faq_q3: What happens if I don’t pass the final check?
marketing.faq_q3_a: You see exactly which lessons need work and where to review them, then you can take it again.
marketing.faq_q4: Does the tutor just give me the answers?
marketing.faq_q4_a: The tutor explains using this course’s material and shows its source. It never helps during the final check.
marketing.faq_q5: What happens to my access when my company’s contract ends?
marketing.faq_q5_a: By default you keep read-only access to what you completed, including your credentials.
marketing.ctaTitle: Start with one module. See if it sticks.
marketing.ctaBody: The first module of every course is free, with the tutor and recall checks included.
marketing.footTagline: Evidence-based courses that people finish and remember.
